about.label: About us
about.title: WELCOME TO HP RESORT.
about.desc: Located in the future business district, in a peaceful and relaxing setting, our discreet establishment is the ideal place for business stays and family vacations. Our hotel, with a capacity of 300 rooms, features a modern conference center equipped with all necessary amenities. Twelve versatile rooms, ranging from 15 to 200 participants, are available along with banquet halls for up to 200 people and other rental spaces in the garden or pool terrace that can accommodate 1,500 guests or more. Our young team of dynamic, available and dedicated professionals is always at your service to ensure a quality stay, rich in emotion and memorable experiences. Be tempted by an immersive experience in Yamoussoukro, in a surprising, original and warm setting. Welcome to HP Resort Hotel!

rooms.label: Hotel rooms and suites
rooms.title: Our rooms
rooms.desc: Our rooms perfectly combine comfort and elegance, designed to offer every guest an exceptional stay. Each room is equipped with soft bedding, high-quality sheets and a choice of pillows, to guarantee you a restful night's sleep.

features.title: Room features
features.closing: Our elegantly appointed rooms are designed to offer the utmost in comfort and style.

event.title: Meetings & Events
event.desc: HP Resort Hotel is the second large-capacity hotel in Yamoussoukro, featuring conference and banquet rooms, making it the ideal venue for your events.

activities.title: Wellness & Relaxation
activities.desc: Our wellness area features several facilities: two individual cabins, a double cabin, a relaxation room, a hammam, a sauna, a hand and foot beauty cabin, and a hair salon.

restaurant.subtitle: Gastronomy & Relaxation
restaurant.heading: Farm to table: savor fresh, seasonal dishes at HP Resort
restaurant.desc: Welcome to HP Resort, where gastronomy meets elegance in the heart of Yamoussoukro. Our restaurants and bars invite you to enjoy exceptional cuisine, combining local Ivorian flavors with international influences, in a refined and soothing setting. Every meal is an invitation to a culinary journey.
restaurant.ourSpacesDesc: Discover our dining spaces, each offering a unique culinary experience in an exceptional setting.

package.title: Our package stays
package.desc: Discover our package stays combining comfort, varied activities and discoveries, for a turnkey travel experience. Enjoy carefully designed offers for a worry-free stay full of memories.

promotion.title: Our Promotions
promotion.desc: Take advantage of our exclusive promotional offers and live unforgettable moments at HP Resort Hotel in Yamoussoukro. Offers designed for every special occasion.
